settings.history: complete active and proposed causal history only after inherited and receiver-shared predictive admission
settings.trigger: original top2 RF-influence families, >=0.5km summed influence, >=30 native points and >=2 tracks
settings.nomination: original full72h causal bank coarse two-longest-track nomination; same finalists botharms
settings.inherited_predictive: original five synchronized5s groups+5s guards; positive mean and >=4/5 wins botharms
settings.candidate_scope: all common nominees including incumbent; conditional on full-data nomination/graph/aliases/cavity calibration
settings.destination_ownership: absent from both baseline-arm owner maps
settings.joint_acceptance: original gates/exact orbit/phase/solver/mixture phase interior/native owner checks, botharms; gains beyond existing shortlist penalty
settings.controls: same two starts and budget under matched active history; bound by best qualified control, matched-prior published endpoint and original published objective
settings.catalogue_eligibility: every381knots error0 and finite states; explicitly exclude only one uniform documented invalid SGP4 code in{1,2,3,4,6} at ALLknots; partial/mixed/unknown/nonfinite-error0 blocks
settings.fallback: exact frozen published baseline on rejection, incomplete search, unexplained/partial/nonfinite propagation, worker failure or hardcap; no partial winner publication
settings.truth: endpoint error metadata only, never nomination/guard/search/selection
